$comment: Everything RapidRoom adds on top of upstream RapidRAW. Edit this file in the same PR as the change; `node rapidroom/status.mjs` renders the README table and CHANGES.md. Fields: id, title, category (fix | feature | performance | privacy | platform | ci), landed (YYYY-MM-DD, date it reached RapidRoom main), authors (GitHub logins), source (rapidroom, or the fork it was harvested from), commits (URLs), upstream_issues and upstream_prs ('owner/repo#n'), rendering_change, notes, highlight (optional: a short, user-facing Markdown line; entries with one are listed under Highlights in the README, everything is in CHANGES.md).

changes.title: Faster raw decoding: highlight recovery and pixel-format conversions run on all CPU cores; the GPU adapter is logged; `rapidraw bench` measures the image pipeline without a window
changes.notes: The parallel conversions are per-pixel and tested bit for bit against the serial code. The bench command follows RapidRoom's headless CLI rules: no window, closed-pipe-safe output, exit 1 on failure and 2 on bad arguments. Upstream's speed-up figures are not yet measured on RapidRoom.

changes.title: White balance picker samples the original linear image (click for a small square, drag for an area) instead of an edited thumbnail, so picks are stable and correct
changes.notes: Rendering pipeline unchanged; only the temperature/tint values the picker produces differ. A hover swatch shows the sampled colour and the resulting temperature/tint.
changes.highlight: **A white balance picker you can trust.** It reads the untouched raw data, averages a square or a dragged area, and shows a live preview before you click, which helps with mixed-light night shots.

changes.title: Tauri 2.12: Native Titlebar works with tiling Wayland compositors (Hyprland)
changes.highlight: **At home on Linux tiling desktops.** The native title bar works with Wayland compositors like Hyprland instead of fighting them.

changes.title: No abort or hang when stdout/stderr is a closed pipe (e.g. `rapidraw … | head`)
Exports embed an sRGB ICC profile (JPEG, PNG, TIFF), so colour-managed apps and print services read them correctly
changes.notes: Pixels unchanged; only the profile tag is added. The TIFF part goes upstream after #1752.
changes.highlight: **Colour-managed exports.** JPEG, PNG and TIFF files carry an sRGB profile, so browsers, other apps and print labs show your colours as intended.

changes.title: Sony lossless M/S raws (A7C II, A7CR) and Canon mRAW/sRAW no longer get green borders
changes.notes: Only the affected files change: their crop is now correct.
changes.highlight: **Sony lossless M/S and Canon mRAW/sRAW raws open correctly**, without the green borders upstream still shows.

changes.title: The Poppins UI font is bundled: no Google Fonts request at startup, and the UI works offline
changes.highlight: **Private and offline by default.** Nothing is contacted at startup except the update check: no Google Fonts, and the cloud sign-in service loads only if you use cloud features.

changes.title: The Clerk sign-in SDK loads only when cloud features are turned on, with telemetry off
The update check looks at RapidRoom releases
CI builds Android unsigned when no signing key is configured, so forks get green builds

changes.source: sheldonxxxx/RapidRAW (extended by yojen7 to newer upstream save paths)
changes.title: Edit and metadata sidecars (.rrdata, .rrexif, XMP) are saved atomically, so a crash, power loss or full disk can't leave a half-written edit
changes.highlight: **Your edits are safer.** Edits are saved crash-safe, a damaged mask no longer wipes out the others, and a corrupt panel layout no longer resets your settings.

changes.title: One unreadable field in a saved mask no longer removes every mask on the image
A corrupt saved panel layout no longer erases all settings at startup
The curve shader no longer indexes past the end of its point array
Float images go to the GPU without a full temporary copy (less memory per edit)
Keyboard focus is visible again on every button (Tab navigation), without rings on mouse clicks
changes.notes: Made with OpenAI Codex. Fixes markallisongit/RapidRAW#30, which applies to upstream too.
changes.highlight: **Keyboard-friendly.** You can always see where keyboard focus is when you Tab through the app.

changes.title: Export presets keep their TIFF bit depth and "set file timestamp from EXIF" settings
EXIF UserComment is written with its character-code header, so other apps read the whole comment
The "maximum AI tags" setting is respected
"RAW only" with "prefer JPEG" grouping shows the RAW files instead of nothing
The library and folder tree refresh after exporting into the source folder
Batch export no longer puts another photo into some outputs: colour and luminance masks are built from the image being exported, and masks are paired with the right adjustments
changes.notes: Only exports with colour/luminance masks (or an empty mask before another mask) change: they now match the editor. Prior art: R-Laine/RapidRAW@d49c341 (same path-keyed idea, different base).
changes.highlight: **Reliable batch exports.** Large exports no longer slip another photo into some images, and colour and luminance masks now apply correctly when exporting.

changes.title: Exported JPEG, PNG and WebP files carry your tags as XMP keywords (dc:subject) when metadata is kept
changes.source: chuckhenrich/RapidRAW (adapted in RapidRoom: colour labels left out, user: prefix stripped, JPEG/WebP placement fixed)
changes.notes: Only with "Keep metadata" on. Not yet for TIFF, AVIF or JXL exports, or for TIFF sources (no metadata is written for those today). The fork commit cites `#1618`, probably the upstream issue; not verified.
changes.highlight: **Your keywords travel with your exports.** Tags you add show up as keywords in Lightroom, digiKam, photo sites and stock agencies.

changes.title: RapidRoom name, logo, app icon and start-screen photo; the start screen credits RapidRAW as the upstream project
changes.notes: The app identifier (settings and data location) is unchanged, so existing RapidRAW settings, presets and library carry over. The start-screen photo is all rights reserved (not AGPL).

changes.title: Frontend test foundation: Vitest with a mocked Tauri API, run on every pull request
changes.notes: Covers settings saving (success and backend failure) and Tauri event listener cleanup. Written with Claude Code.

changes.title: Pasting adjustments works even when the settings failed to load (it used to do nothing)
changes.notes: From the type errors harrytuckerr's fork flagged as likely bugs (`harrytuckerr/RapidRAW#1`). The others (image cache, interactive patch, pinned folders, panel moves) were type-only and are fixed without behaviour changes. Written with Claude Code.

changes.title: Rapid navigation shares one decode slot between editor loads and culling previews; superseded editor loads skip decoding
changes.notes: Editor and culling share a one-permit semaphore. Blocking tasks retain the permit if their awaiting task is cancelled. Culling requests are serialized, not cancelled.

changes.title: Read-only Card mode: browse a memory card without RapidRoom creating, changing or deleting anything on it
changes.source: TomasLiutvinas/RapidRAW (extended by yojen7 to every write path)
changes.notes: The backend refuses every write under the card folder: sidecars, XMP sync and creation, EXIF refresh, tag cleanup, rename, move, copy into, delete, duplicates, virtual copies, and outputs saved next to the originals (export, denoise, HDR, panorama, focus stack, collage, negatives). Edits stay in memory. Written with Claude Code.
changes.highlight: **Browse memory cards safely:** read-only Card mode never writes to the card

changes.title: Previews and exports skip GPU blur passes that no active adjustment reads
changes.notes: Adapted to RapidRoom's shader with Claude Code: sharpening also reads the tonal blur, highlights doesn't, and RapidRoom has no skin smoothing. Output should be pixel-identical; speed-up not measured yet.

changes.title: Star ratings set in the camera (embedded XMP or EXIF Rating) show in the library; a rating you set or clear in RapidRoom always wins
changes.source: csiroqa/RapidRAW (upstream PR, adapted by yojen7 with the explicit-clear idea from masmoriya/RapidRAW)
changes.notes: Reads only the file headers it needs (TIFF-based raws such as Sony ARW, JPEG, Fuji RAF, Canon CR3); never writes a sidecar. A rating cleared before this change looks the same as one never set, so the camera rating shows until it is cleared again. The idea that an empty XMP sidecar must not hide the camera rating comes from moschmdt (upstream PR 1714).
changes.highlight: **Star ratings you set in the camera show up in the library.**

changes.title: Pixel-exact regression check in CI: 18 renders on a software Vulkan renderer (Mesa lavapipe), compared by pixel hash
changes.notes: Runs on pull requests touching src-tauri or the regression harness, on pushes to main and on demand; not a required check yet. Each job renders twice to prove lavapipe is deterministic. The reference (rapidroom/regression/ci-reference.json) is recorded on the runner and committed by a maintainer. Written with Claude Code.

changes.title: BM3D denoise: raising the strength no longer adds noise back
changes.notes: The detail blend re-added up to 50% of the original high frequencies, noise included, and grew with strength. It now matches the old blend up to 33% strength and fades to zero at 100%. Only BM3D denoise output above 33% strength changes; the edit pipeline and its regression renders are untouched. Unit tests check that RMSE against a clean image doesn't rise with strength. Written with Claude Code.

changes.title: Groundwork for camera-matching profiles: a bounds-checked reader for Adobe DCP files (not used by the app yet)
changes.notes: Parser and its synthetic test fixtures only (round-trip, ExtraCameraProfiles, a 10,000-input mutation test); nothing in the render path calls it yet, so output is unchanged. The fork's acceptance test against one vendor file on the author's machine was dropped. Harvested with Claude Code.

changes.title: Culling: optional auto-advance to the next image after rating with a shortcut, and an "exactly N stars" rating filter
changes.notes: Auto-advance is off by default (Settings → General) and only moves on when a single image is rated with the 0–5 keys; it stops at the last image. The ≥/= button next to the rating filter stars switches between "N and up" and "exactly N". Written with Claude Code.
changes.highlight: **Faster culling:** rate with 0–5 and jump straight to the next photo, and filter for exactly N stars.

changes.title: Import Lightroom and Camera Raw XMP sidecars: Basic, HSL, colour grading, curves, vignette, crop and straighten, rating, label and keywords, for one photo or a whole folder tree
changes.source: dimafa/RapidRAW (upstream PR 1465, which builds on StephenMasseur's PR 1280)
changes.notes: Merged with every original commit. Right-click a photo and choose Import XMP Adjustments, or a folder and choose Import Matching XMP Sidecars. The photos are not changed; with XMP sync on, rating, label and keywords are written back to the .xmp as after any edit. An imported Lightroom rating counts as one set in RapidRoom, so it wins over the camera's rating, even when it is 0. RapidRoom routes the sidecar writes through its atomic writer and refuses imports onto a card opened in Card mode. The PR also reworks the existing .xmp preset import (Shadows2012 is now copied 1:1 instead of x1.5, nested Looks are ignored, PV2003/2010 values are read). Lightroom and RapidRAW render differently, so similar values don't give identical images; mapping fixes follow in RapidRoom #54. Harvested with Claude Code.
changes.highlight: **Bring your Lightroom edits along:** import XMP sidecars

changes.title: Window and DPI changes keep the latest preview size even when a render holds the display lock
changes.notes: The latest physical surface size is queued outside the display lock and applied on the next transform, resize, or native preview render. Export processing is unchanged.

changes.title: Editor render caches include virtual image identity so a late preview cannot reuse another photo
changes.notes: Transformed, patched/warped and small-preview cache keys include the full virtual image path. The existing path guard and mask-image snapshot from the batch-export fix are retained; its already image-keyed cache uses the equivalent shared helper. No image-processing math changes.

changes.title: Linux large allocations no longer request transparent huge pages from mimalloc, avoiding compaction stalls on fragmented memory
changes.notes: Allocation-only change: enable mimalloc no_thp and retain the Linux smaps regression test. The allocator version and image-processing math are unchanged. The remaining GPU logging, benchmark and parallel conversion work is tracked in RapidRoom issue #66.

changes.title: Failed headless CLI exports exit with status 1 and say why on stderr (they used to exit 0)
changes.notes: The run-loop exit handler ignored the requested exit code and always called exit(0). A CI job runs the binary under xvfb for a missing input and an unwritable output. Written with Claude Code.

changes.title: Linux release packaging: a .deb and an AppImage named RapidRoom that install side by side with RapidRAW
changes.notes: Binary `rapidroom`, resources in /usr/lib/RapidRoom, RapidRoom.desktop, window class RapidRoom, and its own single-instance D-Bus name. The app identifier (and so the settings folder) is still shared with RapidRAW. A `v*` tag builds a draft release; see rapidroom/RELEASING.md. Written with Claude Code.

changes.title: Denoise dialogs stay open on busy backdrop clicks; Cancel stops waiting and discards the eventual UI result
changes.notes: Another denoise cannot start while a command is pending. Cancellation does not interrupt the backend: single processing may continue and batch work may still write files. Real interruption and job IDs are tracked in RapidRoom #68.

changes.title: DxO compressed DNG highlights no longer wrap to black dots when lookup-table dithering exceeds 16 bits
changes.notes: Dither values above 65535 now saturate instead of wrapping. Unsaturated values and the random-state update are preserved. The fork retains Kheil-Z's Sony/Canon default-crop fixes; the extra tile-fixture change is test-only.
